title: HeartRatePayload
description: Telemetry frame published by an athlete device to `{club_id}/{class_id}/{athlete_id}`. Contains NO PII: identity is carried only by the topic's pseudonymous athlete UUID, and age/max-HR never leave the device (only the derived `effort_pct` does).

bpm.description: Instantaneous heart rate in beats per minute.

effort_pct.description: bpm as a percentage of the athlete's max heart rate, computed ON DEVICE so max HR / age is never transmitted.

ts.description: Device capture time, epoch milliseconds. Informational (latency); storage uses the broker's arrival time because device clocks are untrusted.

seq.description: Monotonic per-connection sequence number; lets consumers drop reordered frames.
